description: Removes a named user effect from a clip via QE removeEffects and verifies it is gone. removeEffects is all-or-nothing, so this only succeeds when the named effect is the SOLE user effect; if other user effects are present it refuses (use remove_all_effects). Intrinsic Motion/Opacity/Volume and Lumetri Color cannot be removed. No-op if the effect is already absent.

effectName.description: (required) Effect/component display or match name; alternate: name.

sequenceId.description: Target sequence id; active sequence if omitted.

name: remove_effect
